::: {#def-npsem .theorem}
## Non-parametric structural equation model \[NPSEM\]

A [statistical model](#def-statistical-model) characterized by a set of deterministic functions called structural equations. Each structural equation $f_V$ returns the value of a [random variable](#def-random-variable) $V$ in the model. It is a function of the other random variables as well as a random error term $U$: 

$$
\theta =\{f_{V}(\mathbf V_{-V}, U_V):V\in\mathbf V\}.
$$

Where $\mathbf V_{-V}$ denotes the sub-vector of $\mathbf V$ that excludes $V$. By definition, no random variable is directly or indirectly a function of itself, so we can order the random variables and write each as a function of prior random variables: 

$$
V_{j} \;=\; f_{V_j}\!\big( V_{1},\dots,V_{j-1},\, U_{V_j} \big).
$$

:::
